name: quality-transformation-coach-mcp
description: MCP server for software quality transformation coaching — 16 tools for code analysis (complexity, coverage, test patterns, flaky tests), issue/defect analysis (trends, hotspots, root causes), CI/CD health (readiness scans, pipeline status, test results, quality gates), AI readiness (AI maturity scan), and knowledge/maturity (TMMi assessments, ISO 25010 lookup, quality reporting). Embedded knowledge base with ISO 25010, TMMi, test patterns, quality gates, CI/CD readiness, and AI readiness.

tools.name: analyze_code_quality
tools.description: Scan a repository for code quality metrics (complexity, duplication, smells).

tools.name: analyze_test_coverage
tools.description: Analyze test coverage by comparing test files against source files.

tools.name: detect_test_patterns
tools.description: Detect test patterns and anti-patterns in a repository.

tools.name: analyze_flaky_tests
tools.description: Detect flaky tests from CI run data.

tools.name: defect_trend_analysis
tools.description: Analyze issue trends (volume, resolution time, severity) for a repository.

tools.name: quality_hotspot_detection
tools.description: Identify files with the highest defect density (hotspots).

tools.name: root_cause_categories
tools.description: Categorise closed bugs by root cause (code, design, requirements, security).

tools.name: pipeline_health
tools.description: Analyze CI/CD pipeline health (success rate, duration trends).

tools.name: test_result_summary
tools.description: Get test results summary for a specific CI workflow run.

tools.name: cicd_readiness_scan
tools.description: Run a CI/CD Readiness Scan assessment with 102 questions across 5 domains.

tools.name: ai_readiness_scan
tools.description: Run an AI Readiness Scan assessment with 60 questions across 5 AI domains.

tools.name: quality_gate_check
tools.description: Check if quality gates are met for a project.

tools.name: maturity_assessment
tools.description: Run a TMMi maturity assessment for a project.

tools.name: framework_lookup
tools.description: Look up information about a quality framework (ISO 25010, TMMi).

tools.name: generate_quality_report
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive Markdown quality report.
